entities.name: Muhammad Rahim Bahadur Khan II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sayyid Muhammad Rahim Bahadur Khan II was Khan of Khiva of the Uzbek ”Kongirad” Dynasty from 1864 to 1910, succeeding his father Sayyid Muhammad Khan. Khiva was turned into a Russian protectorate during his rule, in 1873.
